persona: Branch relationship manager with four years in retail liabilities and investment sales
resumeText:
Karthik Iyer | Chennai | karthik.iyer@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Relationship Manager - Branch Banking, Coromandel Bank Ltd, Chennai (2023 - present)
- Handle client portfolio management for 320 mapped savings and affluent customers at the Adyar branch.
- Drive CASA acquisition through society camps, builder tie-ups and walk-in customers.
- Grew mutual fund sales and SIP book by pitching equity and hybrid funds to existing customers.
- Sold term and health policies through bancassurance with the bank's insurance partner.
- Cross-selling credit cards, personal loans and lockers to customers during account reviews.
- Complete KYC documentation and account opening forms and clear branch audit queries.
- Resolve customer complaints and service requests with branch operations within the turnaround time.

Personal Banker, Coromandel Bank Ltd, Chennai (2021 - 2023)
- Opened savings and fixed deposit accounts for walk-in customers and completed KYC checks.

EDUCATION
B.Com, University of Madras, 2021

CERTIFICATIONS
NISM-Series-V-A Mutual Fund Distributors; IRDAI IC-38

Investor risk profiling, Finacle, Excel
